test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on an amount of Rs. 8,000 at 5% p.a. for 2 years, compounded annually.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Amount = 8000

Rate = 5%

Time = 2 years

**FORMULA USED:**

A = P × (1 + r / 100)t

**SOLUTION:**

⇒ A = P × (1 + r / 100)t

⇒ A = 8000 × (1 + 5 / 100)²

⇒ A = 8000 × (1.05)²

⇒ A = 8820

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal

⇒ CI = 8820 - 8000

⇒ CI = 820

**Hence option 3 is the correct answer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**⇒ __Principle__ → __Amount__

⇒ 1st yr. 20 → 21

⇒ 2nd yr. 20 → 21

⇒ __For 2 yrs complete.__

⇒ Principle = (20)² = 400

⇒ Amount = (21)² = 441

⇒ But according to Question,

⇒ 400 → 8000

⇒ 1 → 20

**∴ Compound Interest = 41 → 41 × 20 = 820.**
